extraction.notes: Three months ended June 30, 2022. Starts from Net income available for MAA common shareholders (not net income). AFFO is 'Core AFFO', starting from Core FFO. Zero-value line 'Loss on debt extinguishment' omitted (shown as dash). Gain on non-depreciable real estate (355) categorized as nareit_other since the depreciable-gain category does not apply. Mark-to-market debt adjustment (35) is a debt-related item in interest expense, categorized as debt_cost_amortization. COVID-19 related costs categorized as other. Capex lines after Core AFFO (redevelopment, revenue enhancing, commercial, other) are FAD items and were excluded from AFFO. Checks: FFO 216,162/118,638 = 1.82; Core FFO 239,856/118,638 = 2.02; Core AFFO 208,899/118,638 = 1.76. All subtotals foot.
